A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cell cycle regulator OSD1 is involved in plant immunity by regulating R genes.
cell cycle regulation and plant immunity are linked by a mechanism that involves the APC/C complex.

the cell cycle is a major regulator of plant immunity and that the cell cycle may be a major regulator of immune response.
